0022600137.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-3, on a two-game losing streak) host the New York Knicks (0-3, on a three-game skid) in Chicago's fifth game of the 2026-27 season, with the Bulls fourth in the Central, 2.5 games back, and 11th in the East, while the Knicks are 13th in the East. Nic Claxton is out for Chicago with a hamstring injury, and Patrick Williams (groin soreness) and Tobe Awaka (ankle) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, while New York will be without Jose Alvarado, who is out with an ankle sprain. The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Bulls lost the season series 1-3, including a 136-96 loss in New York on April 3, 2026.
